reviews.title: Forces Updated loads in middle of games
reviews.text:
I Did love this game.  But it would stop frequently to tell me that I had to “Upload “ the “Latest Version “
I have a degree in Computer Systems, Versions of a Game do NOT “Update “ Several times a DAY.
It was doing this even in the middle of games.
I had a lot of coins won and would lose them each time.
Annoying is not the same thing as relaxing so I deleted the game.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: I thought that I had finally found a word game that I truly enjoyed and that wasn’t designed to rob me of large sums of money. I was wrong. I made one purchase and that was to remove ads. I claimed all my bonuses and I watched ads in order to earn more coins. My coin balance was in excess of 116,000 coins. Yesterday, I played the game for a few hours in the morning. When I returned to the game in the afternoon, my coin balance of over 116,000 coins had been changed to exactly 600 coins! I guess the developers realized that I had no need to spend money in order to purchase tokens and they decided to almost completely wipe out my coin balance. From over 116,000 coins to 600! Truly disgusting! I immediately deleted this scam game!
